title: issues row
description: Field table 03 L65-76; nine kinds 03 L78-90; write rules 03 L92.

assignee.description: 03 L70; reassign appends a version with a new assignee (03 L92)

stage.description: required when kind is failed (03 L72)

reply.description: required when status is answered (03 L74)

handoff_id.description: required when kind is cannot, failed, denied, withdrawn or orphaned; optional otherwise (03 L75; 09 is the same, 20 L92 lists a different set and is not the definition)

log_tail.description: the last 40 log lines as text; rl truncates --log-tail FILE, --log-text - reads stdin; no path is stored (03 L76)

x-conditions.rule: reply may be written only by the assignee or gyb
close may be written only by the opening actor or gyb; for notification kinds (withdrawn, orphaned, fyi) also by the assignee
handoff accept closes the answered issues linked to that order
